title: Forced Displacement and Social Capital in the Long Run: Lessons from the Indian Partition
title_zh: 长期被迫流离失所与社会资本：印度分治的教训
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of migrant inflows due to forced displacement events on the social capital in the recipient societies. We exploit the setting of Partition of India. Using data from districts in post 1947 India belonging to six states that saw a higher inflow of migrants, relative to outflow, we analyse how the â€˜shock' inflow of migrants affected social capital in the districts sixty years later. The shock is measured as the proportion of "displacedâ€ migrants in Indian districts in 1951 from census data. Survey data conducted in 2007 indicates that social capital is lower in districts that received more Partition migrants. The effect remains strongly robust to spatial robustness checks, contemporary differences in a host of demographic and public goods provision indicators. We find that these effects are mediated through riots, community conflicts and violent crime that start from Partition sixty years ago and continue through to more recent times. We also find that political participation, a proxy for social capital, falls over time in districts which see a relatively larger flow of displaced migrants. Our study contributes to the understanding of the long run implications of large forced displacement events.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了因被迫迁移事件导致的移民流入对接收地社会资本的影响。我们以印度分治为背景，利用1947年后印度六个移民净流入较高地区的县级数据，分析了六十年前移民的“冲击性”流入如何影响这些地区的社会资本。基于1951年人口普查数据，我们将冲击量化为印度各县“流离失所”移民的比例。2007年的调查数据显示，接收更多分治移民的县社会资本水平较低。这一效应在空间稳健性检验以及当代人口与公共品供给指标差异的控制下依然显著。研究发现，这些影响通过分治时期开始并延续至今的骚乱、社区冲突和暴力犯罪等中介机制发挥作用。此外，在流离失所移民流入相对较多的县，政治参与度（社会资本的代理变量）随时间推移而下降。本研究有助于理解大规模被迫迁移事件的长期影响。

title: Targeting State Aid: Firm-level Evidence from France
title_zh: 定向国家援助：来自法国的企业层面证据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the firm-level impact of state aid in France from 2016–23 and how targeting affects economic outcomes. Using firm-level data and a difference-in-differences approach, we find that aid is most effective for young firms, improving real outcomes while also crowding in private debt financing. Size-based targeting, by contrast, has limited impact. R&D support is particularly effective for young firms in high-tech sectors, and energy aid has the strongest effects in manufacturing, pointing to its potential role in helping firms reduce emissions and facilitating the green transition.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2016至2023年间法国国家援助对企业层面的影响，以及援助目标设定如何影响经济结果。利用企业层面数据与双重差分方法，我们发现援助对年轻企业最为有效，既能改善实际经济表现，也能带动私人债务融资。相比之下，基于规模的援助目标设定效果有限。研发支持对高科技行业的年轻企业尤为有效，而能源援助在制造业中效果最为显著，这表明其在帮助企业减少排放、推动绿色转型方面具有潜在作用。

title: Education, marriage, and banning female genital cutting: evidence from Benin
title_zh: 教育、婚姻与禁止女性割礼：来自贝宁的证据
abstract: Using the 2003 ban of female genital cutting in Benin as a natural experiment, I estimate the effect of the ban on women’s human capital accumulation. The ban decreases the likelihood of a woman undergoing genital cutting despite inconsistent enforcement. Banning female genital cutting has a counter-intuitive effect on women’s education. A difference-in-differences estimation indicates that the ban decreases women’s years of education, the probability of completing primary school, and the probability of starting secondary school. I show that the decrease in educational outcomes is accompanied by an increase in marriage and increased spousal match quality. The negative effect on women’s education dissipates following the implementation of free primary education in Benin.
abstract_zh: 以2003年贝宁禁止女性割礼作为自然实验，本文评估了该禁令对女性人力资本积累的影响。尽管执法力度不一，该禁令仍降低了女性接受割礼的可能性。禁止女性割礼对女性教育产生了反直觉效应。双重差分估计表明，该禁令减少了女性受教育年限、完成小学教育的概率以及进入中学的概率。本文发现，教育成果的下降伴随着婚姻缔结率的上升和配偶匹配质量的提升。随着贝宁免费初等教育的实施，该禁令对女性教育的负面效应逐渐消失。

title: Optimal Contracting in Agency with Verifiable Ex Post Information
title_zh: 事后可验证信息下的最优代理合同
authors: Anke Kessler, Christoph Lülfesmann, Patrick W. Schmitz
official: 官方在线 2002-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The Paper studies a straightforward adverse selection problem in which an informative but imperfect signal on the agent?s type becomes public ex post. The agent is protected by limited liability, which rules out unboundedly high penalties. Analysing the consequences of the additional information and the corresponding extension of the space of feasible contracts, the following conclusions emerge. First, the qualitative effects of the signal can be unambiguously tied to the nature of the underlying problem (e.g., whether the agent is in a ?buyer? or a ?seller? position). Second, the joint surplus of the relationship may well fall, i.e., the distortions due to informational asymmetries can become more pronounced although more information is now available. Finally, the agent may benefit from releasing additional signals because of an associated increase in expected informational rents.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个直接的逆向选择问题，其中关于代理人类型的具有信息量但不完美的信号在事后公开。代理人受到有限责任保护，这排除了无限高的惩罚。通过分析额外信息的后果以及可行契约空间的相应扩展，得出以下结论。首先，信号的定性效应可以明确地与潜在问题的性质相关联（例如，代理人处于“买方”还是“卖方”地位）。其次，关系的联合剩余可能会下降，即尽管现在可获得更多信息，但信息不对称导致的扭曲可能变得更加显著。最后，代理人可能因释放额外信号而受益，因为与之相关的预期信息租金会增加。
